title: Coachella promoter Goldenvoice renews its livestreaming partnership with YouTube through 2030, choosing it over competing bids from Netflix and Amazon (Lucas Shaw/Bloomberg)
summary: Lucas Shaw / Bloomberg: Coachella promoter Goldenvoice renews its livestreaming partnership with YouTube through 2030, choosing it over competing bids from Netflix and Amazon — New deal includes mini artist documentaries and more programming leading up to North America's largest music festival.
